meta.name: lifecycle-messaging
meta.description: Designs automated email and SMS programs — welcome and onboarding sequences, nurture, re-engagement, transactional messaging, and the timing and segmentation behind them. Use this to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, improve open or click performance, set up SMS flows, or decide what messages a customer should receive and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并优化客户的邮件与短信自动触达流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要搭建客户邮件或短信的自动营销流程
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize automated email and SMS customer journeys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run customer messaging and need automated email or SMS flows.

howto.what: 装好后，你请它设计或优化自动化邮件/短信时，它会先梳理客户从注册到流失的阶段，再输出欢迎序列步骤、发送时机、行为触发建议，以及主题行和短信合规等具体方案。
howto.when: 当你说要设计或修复邮件序列、规划生命周期自动化、设置短信流等自动化消息相关的任务时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新的欢迎邮件序列
say.note: 它会先询问你的新用户目标，再给出各阶段邮件内容与发送时机。

say.text: 我邮件的打开率很低，帮我找找原因
say.note: 它会让你先检查送达与列表质量，再看主题行和文案。

say.text: 给流失的老客户写一条短信挽留话术
say.note: 它会在发送前提醒短信合规要求，再给你草拟稿。

howto.what_en: Claude designs email/SMS programs by first mapping lifecycle stages. It outputs welcome-sequence steps, behavior-based timing, and compliance reminders; it can also diagnose low open/click or high unsubscribe.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, set up SMS flows, or handle similar automated-messaging tasks.

say_en.text: Design a new welcome email sequence for me.
say_en.note: It maps stages and proposes timing and content per email.

say_en.text: My open rates are low. Help me find why.
say_en.note: It tells you to check delivery and list quality before copy.

say_en.text: Write an SMS win-back message for lapsed customers.
say_en.note: It reminds you of SMS compliance before drafting.
